sections.description:
🛍️ Take the busywork out of WooCommerce price updates. Tasbeeh Price Editor is a practical bulk price editor that helps store managers find simple products, select the right price fields, and apply consistent bulk pricing adjustments—with clear per-product results to help review the outcome. Developed by a2zwoosolutions, this woocommerce bulk editor provides straightforward pricing management directly inside your WordPress dashboard.

✨ Simple WooCommerce Bulk Pricing

This woocommerce product editor lets store managers filter WooCommerce simple products, select products, and apply supported price changes.

  • 🗂️ Filter by category, stock status, and product status (all three are required).
  • 🎯 Select individual products or all displayed results.
  • 💵 Increase or decrease prices by a fixed amount, or set a new price where supported.
  • 🧾 Review per-product validation and update results.

Looking for a reliable bulk product editing plugin or an easy-to-use woocommerce plugin? Explore the pricing features and discover more WooCommerce solutions from a2zwoosolutions.

🚀 Quick Start: Six Visual Steps

Follow the six animated GIF guides in order. Each step demonstrates an essential part of the bulk pricing workflow.

  1. Open the editor. Go to Products > Price Changer in your WordPress dashboard.
  1. Choose filters. Select a category, stock status, and product status. All three are required.
  1. Load and select products. Apply filters, review matching simple products, and select individual products or all displayed results.
  1. Choose the price field. Select Regular price, Sale price, or Both price.
  1. Configure pricing. Choose a fixed-amount increase, fixed-amount decrease, or supported set-new-price operation; enter the amount.
  1. Apply and review. Run the update and check each product’s result message.

⚠️ Important: The free edition supports simple products and returns up to 100 results per filter request. Set new price is unavailable with Both price. Negative prices and sale prices above regular prices are not allowed. Review selected products and price fields before applying changes.

Explore this bulk price editor and its woocommerce bulk editor capabilities to understand the available pricing workflow.

🧩 Features: Free and Premium

The free edition focuses on fixed-amount bulk changes for simple products. The premium edition adds product search and broader editing controls for more advanced WooCommerce stores.

🆓 Free Features

  1. 🧰 Bulk price editor — manage prices directly from the WooCommerce dashboard.
  2. 🗂️ Category filter — narrow products by category.
  3. 📦 Stock-status filter — narrow products by stock status.
  4. 📝 Product-status filter — narrow products by publication status.
  5. 🎯 Combined filtering — use all three required filters together.
  6. 🛒 Simple-product support — edit WooCommerce simple products.
  7. ☑️ Product selection — select individual products or all displayed results.
  8. 💵 Regular-price targeting — target regular prices.
  9. 🏷️ Sale-price targeting — target sale prices.
  10. 🔄 Both-price targeting — target both price fields where supported.
  11. 📈 Fixed-amount increase — add a fixed amount.
  12. 📉 Fixed-amount decrease — subtract a fixed amount.
  13. ✏️ Set a new price — replace a supported price; unavailable with Both price.
  14. 🧾 Validation and results — validate pricing and show per-product outcomes.
  15. 🔢 Result limit — up to 100 matching products per filter request.

This woocommerce product editor provides essential pricing functionality without unnecessary complexity.

⭐ A2Z Bulk Price Changer Premium — Premium Features

The premium edition includes shared bulk-editing capabilities, plus:

  1. 🔎 Product search — find products by name or SKU with suggestions.
  2. 🧩 Product-type filtering — filter by product type.
  3. 🎛️ Variable-product support — edit variable products and variations in bulk.
  4. 📊 Percentage adjustments — increase or decrease prices by percentage.
  5. ⚖️ Combined regular and sale pricing — set regular and sale prices together.
  6. ⚡ Individual Quick Edit — edit an individual product.
  7. 🔧 Variation-level editing — edit individual variation prices.
  8. 🗑️ Product deletion control — use the included deletion control.

💡 Recommendation: Choose Free for simple products and fixed-amount changes. Choose Premium for product/SKU search, variable products, percentage adjustments, variation editing, Quick Edit, or product deletion controls.

Explore the bulk price editor and bulk product editing plugin solutions for additional pricing and product management capabilities.

⚠️ Compatibility: Free and Premium share PHP function names and constants. Do not activate both at once. Deactivate the free edition before activating the premium edition.

For additional WooCommerce tools, explore a2zwoosolutions.

📥 Installation

  1. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New Plugin.
  3. Search for the plugin and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Open Products > Price Changer.

Alternatively, upload the ZIP through Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin.

This woocommerce plugin integrates its pricing management interface directly into the existing WooCommerce dashboard.

Discover more bulk product editing plugin solutions from a2zwoosolutions.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

WordPress.org readme files do not support native collapsible accordion controls. For compatibility, each question is presented as a clear heading with its answer directly below.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Which products can the free edition edit?

Simple products only. Variable products and variations require the premium edition.

Which filters are available?

Category, stock status, and product status. All three are required.

How many products are returned?

The free edition returns up to 100 matching products per filter request.

Which price operations are supported?

Fixed-amount increases and decreases, plus set-new-price where supported. Target Regular price, Sale price, or Both price. Set new price is unavailable with Both price.

Can the free edition make percentage changes?

No. Percentage adjustments are a premium feature.

Can the free and premium editions run together?

No. Deactivate the free edition before activating the premium edition because the builds share PHP function names and constants.

Why is a price update rejected?

Negative prices are not accepted, and sale prices cannot exceed regular prices. Check the per-product result message.

For more information, explore this woocommerce bulk editor and the other solutions available from a2zwoosolutions.

⚙️ Requirements and Compatibility

Minimum requirements

  • 🧱 WordPress 6.9 or later.
  • 🐘 PHP 7.4 or later.
  • 🛒 WooCommerce installed and activated.
  • 🔐 The manage_woocommerce capability is required for the administration screen and AJAX actions.

Operational recommendations

  • 🧪 Test on a staging environment before changing a live catalog.
  • 💾 Back up the store before large bulk operations.
  • 🔍 Review selected products and price fields before applying changes.

This bulk product editing plugin is intended for WooCommerce stores that need accessible product pricing management.

🛠️ Troubleshooting

  • Price Changer is missing: Confirm WooCommerce is active and your account has manage_woocommerce.
  • Filters cannot be applied: Select a category, stock status, and product status.
  • No products appear: Check whether simple products match all selected filters.
  • An update fails: Check the result message. Negative prices and sale prices above regular prices are not allowed.
  • Results seem incomplete: The free edition returns up to 100 products per filter request.
  • Unexpected selection: Recheck filters and selected products before applying.

For the best results, review the selected products and pricing fields before running bulk operations.

Explore additional woocommerce product editor solutions from a2zwoosolutions.

🔒 Privacy

The plugin uses locally stored WooCommerce product data. The inspected free source does not implement analytics, telemetry, external account connections, or a remote product-data API.

🌐 External Services

The free edition uses no external service for core filtering or price updates. Optional external website links are subject to the linked website’s privacy policy and terms.

For more information about available WooCommerce tools, visit a2zwoosolutions.
